strings.mdKbSmart: • Kopwe angei ew pisekin angang mei tipachem: a cheki ewe pisekin angang mei nomw ren Google ewe list ren an epwe niwinsefan (CRL) me a sotuni chommong neni tori an epwe kuna ew pisekin angang mei pung, ren ew otot me ew niwinin angangen Google. A fiti iteiten tappin me a namot internet (1-3 minich).
strings.mdKbNet: • Kii seni ewe netip: a angei ew kii seni ewe nenien iseis (GitHub) me a isoni ngeni /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. A namwot internet me a tori 1-3 minich. A aea nupwen ewe smart fetch a fis ika nupwen ewe kii a siwin ren poun.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: a cheki ekkewe mokutukut mi kawor ren ewe angangen awora pisekin pwarata, a cheki ewe TEE kinikinin ewe taropwen pwarata, me a pwarata ewe napanapen pisekin angang KmInstallKeybox. Ese siwin och mettoch — ew nenien nengeni nonomun device mi fatafatoch.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Cheki (anneani chok): a pwarata ekkewe esisinen niwinin (ekkesiwinin) seni ekkewe dumpsys, ewe DRM (IDM) mei nomw non ewe ki-file, me ekkewe pisekin system mei riri ngeni. Mofi ese wor och mettoch.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Ewe puken RKP fichi: a fis ewe puken /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh. A awenewena ekkewe osukosuken pwarata nupwen ewe otot pass ese fis. Iteiten run a printini ew line mi fatafatoch ren fefeita/feiengaw.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Pwungun RKP fichi: fiti sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh unusen. A ataweei ekkewe case mi weires me a fis fansoun langattam. Eú mwirilóón mi ffat a pwá lón lesópwólóón.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Kopwe niwinsefaniti GMS: epwe amoielo ekkewe pisekin angang (GMS+GSF) me epwe niwinsefaniti ewe pisek. Ren pwarata mi pochokun chok — ese kan tori om kewe sasing ika file.
strings.mdCertify: • Taropwen pwarata: cheki ewe RKP taropwen pwarata usun nonomun ewe pisek me a niwinsefaniti ekkewe pisekin pwarata ika pwe mi namot. Ese tori ewe data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER fori sefani: a awenewena ekkewe osukosuken Google kokkotun angang (SOTER) mei riri ngeni ewe angangen pwarata usun pisekin angang. A aea ren ekkoch pisek mi anongonong won SOTER nap seni ewe Pwarata.
strings.mdPifApply: • Kopwe aea PIF: epwe fiti sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh pochokun. A aea ewe pisekin pwarata mi kefinita (non/non) me awenewena ekkewe pif.prop/pif.json. Eú pwóróus mi ffat a pwá lón ewe taropwe.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF cheki: a pwarata ewe napanapen ewe engine mi nomw, ekkewe pisekin pwarata (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), me ekkewe taropwe. Cheki chok — ese siwini och mettoch.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. A angei ewe minefoon puken Canary Engine pwe epwe anisi ekkewe taropwen mumuta mi mumuta ren RKP (Fepueri 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Cheki ewe engine: cheki ewe napanap TrickyStoreOSS (pid, ekkewe taropwe), ekkewe pisekin kii (mi angang vs chon aea), ewe wesewesen vs chon aea ewe pisekin angang mi chofona, ekkewe kii. Pwarata chok.
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ Achocho ngeni ewe seken → ewe aewin
strings.hintKbSlots: Ewe module a nemeni ruu nenien keybox: ewe aewin (mi pin, ese mwo fis) me ewe aruwen (backup). Ei tab a pwarata menni slot a angang, siwini ewe mochen, ika apochokuna ewe aruwen ngeni ewe aewin won tingor mi fatafatoch — ren backups me ew unusen log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Cheki ika mei wor wenechar: a cheki ewe TEE kii, ewe injection non ewe kii2, ewe napanapen niwinin (CRL), ewe nenien tumun-list me ewe RKP nonomun. Kopwe anneani chok — ese siwini och mettoch.
